new_facts.topic: AI capex driving free cash flow outflow

fragments.text: Free cash flow decreased to an outflow of $7.6 billion for the trailing twelve months, driven primarily by a year-over-year increase of $66.1 billion in purchases of property and equipment, net of proceeds from sales and incentives. This increase primarily reflects investments in artificial intelligence.
Purchases of property and equipment, net of proceeds from sales and incentives -- TTM | $87,978 | $102,953 | $115,903 | $128,320 | $147,299 | $169,007 | 64 | %

new_facts.why_it_matters: The free cash flow outflow is mainly due to increased property and equipment purchases, primarily for AI investments.

new_facts.topic: New AI investments and cloud credits

fragments.text: Announced an investment of $1 billion to create AWS Forward Deployed Engineering, a team of AI engineers embedded directly with customers to co-develop and deploy agentic AI solutions in days rather than months.

Announced general availability of AWS Secret Cloud for Industry, giving defense contractors a faster, more secure path to classified innovation, with Northrop Grumman first to run classified workloads on the platform, and committed up to $1 billion in cloud credits to accelerate U.S. Intelligence Community cloud migration and modernization.

new_facts.why_it_matters: New investments and credits expand AI and cloud services, affecting future AWS revenue and infrastructure spending.
Long-term debt increased, with significant proceeds in 2026, likely funding AI infrastructure investments.
